guidelines.detail: refines FLOW-07 (The description establishes an ongoing reporting obligation and later says a particular outcome changes whether it continues. The generated task corresponds to the reference activity, so this is a placement/recurrence mistake, not a missing activity. FLOW-07 already covers representing stated repetition with an exit; this guideline adds how to model a later outcome that changes or stops future rep)

same as LRN-039 (The label pairs show generated activities and gateways substituting different actions, decisions, or outcomes for those described. The descriptions provide distinctions across activities and stages. LRN-039 already addresses preserving those stated distinctions in BPMN labels.)

refines FID-02 (The description states that both parties can give a rating after the same phase. The generated rating task appears to correspond to the company-rating activity, but the other party’s distinct action is absent. This refines the documented guidance to preserve separate actions by specifying how to model actions assigned to different parties.)

same as LRN-039 (The generated gateway labels substitute different decisions or outcomes, and the task label changes the described action. The description supports preserving these distinctions in BPMN labels; this is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-039.)

refines FID-02 (The description states that both parties can rate one another after probation (S6). The generated model includes an activity corresponding to one direction (X7), while the other direction has no counterpart (M4). This refines FID-02 by clarifying that separately described reciprocal actions should remain distinct.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an ongoing obligation and separately states that a later outcome can end or alter it: Model the obligation as recurring from the point it applies, and model the later outcome as changing or stopping future repetitions rather than gating whether the obligation is performed at all.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an ongoing obligation and separately states that a later outcome can end or alter it

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies distinct activities, decisions, or outcomes in different stages or contexts.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns distinct actions to different parties at the same stage of a process: Model each stated party action as a separate BPMN activity and assign it to the responsible participant or lane.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns distinct actions to different parties at the same stage of a process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two participants each perform an action toward the other: model a distinct activity for each stated direction
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two participants each perform an action toward the other

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a condition that determines which alternative path is taken: Label the corresponding BPMN gateway with that stated condition, rather than with an adjacent activity or a downstream outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a condition that determines which alternative path is taken
